name: Apex SEO Intelligence
author: Apex Digital ⭐

sections.description:
Apex SEO Intelligence helps WordPress site owners, agencies, and growth teams understand what is happening in organic search and what to fix next.

Instead of forcing you to dig through raw Search Console tables, Apex SEO Intelligence organizes clicks, impressions, CTR, rankings, pages, queries, devices, countries, and opportunity signals into a polished SEO command center built for decisions.

Use it to find SEO problems faster, identify keywords close to page one, understand which pages are losing clicks, prioritize technical and content improvements, and communicate SEO performance with clean executive-ready views.

Why Apex SEO Intelligence?

SEO teams do not need more scattered data. They need the next best action.

Apex SEO Intelligence is designed to help you:

  • Find high-impact SEO opportunities before they disappear.
  • Improve rankings by focusing on keywords and pages with the strongest upside.
  • Track keyword growth, CTR movement, impressions, clicks, and average position.
  • Understand technical SEO and content issues in one operational view.
  • Monitor backlink, competitor, and reporting workflows as the platform expands.
  • Save time preparing stakeholder updates and executive SEO summaries.
  • Connect organic search performance to business outcomes, traffic growth, and revenue potential.

Benefits

Find SEO problems faster

Quickly see which pages have strong impressions but weak CTR, which keywords are stuck just outside page one, and which opportunities deserve attention first.

Improve rankings with better priorities

Priority scoring helps you focus on changes that can realistically move rankings, clicks, and revenue instead of chasing low-value tasks.

Track keyword growth

Monitor clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position across 7, 30, and 90 day views so you can see whether SEO work is gaining momentum.

Understand business impact

Revenue intelligence estimates the value of organic search traffic and highlights missed opportunity from underperforming pages and keywords.

Report with confidence

Export data and use executive-style dashboard views to communicate organic search performance without rebuilding reports manually.

Features

Monitoring

  • Google Search Console integration for authorized properties.
  • SEO score and organic health snapshot.
  • Clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position tracking.
  • 7, 30, and 90 day performance views.
  • Device and country search traffic breakdowns.
  • Last-updated status and connected property context.

Optimization

  • Keyword opportunity scoring.
  • Page-level performance analysis.
  • CTR optimization suggestions.
  • Low-hanging fruit detection for keywords near page one.
  • Action insights for title, content, ranking, and CTR improvements.
  • Priority actions ranked by estimated impact.

Business Intelligence

  • Estimated SEO revenue value.
  • Lost opportunity detection.
  • Revenue potential from CTR and ranking improvements.
  • Executive overview metrics for stakeholders.
  • Search trend snapshots and organic growth indicators.

Reporting

  • Dashboard overview for daily SEO management.
  • Keyword and page tables with sortable performance context.
  • CSV export for deeper spreadsheet analysis.
  • PDF export workflow for client, founder, or leadership reporting.
  • Reviewer-safe demo mode when real Search Console data is unavailable.

External Services

This plugin connects to Google Search Console APIs to retrieve search performance and indexing data for sites authorized by the user.

Data transmitted:

  • Authorized Google OAuth tokens.
  • Search Console property URLs.
  • Search Console query requests.

Google Privacy Policy:
https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google Terms:
https://policies.google.com/terms

This plugin also connects to the Apex Digital OAuth Broker service to securely manage Google OAuth authentication.

Data transmitted:

  • OAuth authorization codes.
  • OAuth refresh tokens.
  • Authentication requests.

Privacy Policy:
https://apexdigital.design/privacy-policy/

Terms of Service:
https://apexdigital.design/terms-of-service/

Roadmap

Future updates are planned to deepen the platform with expanded technical SEO auditing, backlink intelligence, competitor tracking, executive reporting workflows, and advanced AI recommendation capabilities.

Roadmap items are provided for transparency and may change based on user feedback, WordPress.org guidelines, and product readiness.

Support

For support, visit Apex Digital or use the WordPress.org support forum for this plugin.

Before opening a support request, please include:

  • WordPress version.
  • PHP version.
  • Whether Google Search Console is connected.
  • The Search Console property type you are using.
  • A short description of the dashboard or connection issue.

Troubleshooting

The dashboard is empty

Confirm that Google Search Console is connected, the selected property has data, and the WordPress user has permission to view the dashboard.

Google connection fails

Reconnect from the Settings screen and confirm the Google account has access to the selected Search Console property.

My numbers look different from Search Console

Check the selected date range and property. Search Console data can also update on a delay.

Exports do not include expected rows

Make sure the dashboard has loaded data for the active date range before exporting.
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Upload the Apex SEO Intelligence plugin ZIP or install it from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Open Apex SEO Intelligence from the WordPress admin menu.
  5. Click Connect Google to authorize Google Search Console.
  6. Choose the Search Console property you want to monitor.
  7. Review the dashboard overview, keyword opportunities, page insights, and action priorities.

For best results, connect a property that already has Google Search Console data. New sites may need time to collect meaningful search performance history.
sections.faq:
Do I need Google Search Console?

Yes. Apex SEO Intelligence uses Google Search Console data so your dashboard reflects real organic search performance for properties you authorize.

What happens if I have not connected Google yet?

The plugin can show reviewer-safe demo data so you can understand the dashboard layout. Connect Google Search Console when you are ready to view real site performance.

Does Apex SEO Intelligence change my site automatically?

No. The plugin provides SEO intelligence, recommendations, scoring, and reporting. You decide which content, technical, or optimization changes to make.

Can I use this for client reporting?

Yes. The dashboard is designed for agencies, consultants, founders, and operators who need clear SEO performance views and exportable reporting.

What kind of opportunities does it find?

It highlights keywords near page one, pages with strong impressions but low CTR, declining search visibility, ranking opportunities, and revenue potential from organic traffic improvements.

Does it support WooCommerce or revenue-focused sites?

Yes. Apex SEO Intelligence is especially useful for content, service, ecommerce, and WooCommerce sites that want to connect SEO performance to business outcomes.

Will it slow down my website?

The dashboard runs inside the WordPress admin area and is designed to keep SEO analysis separate from the public visitor experience.

Can I export data?

Yes. CSV and PDF export workflows are included for reporting, analysis, and stakeholder communication.

Is my Search Console data public?

No. Search Console data is retrieved for authorized users and displayed inside your WordPress admin dashboard.

What should I do first after connecting Google?

Start with the Overview, then review Quick Wins and Priority Actions. Those views are designed to show the fastest path from raw SEO data to practical next steps.
